description: This Dart source file defines the AuthProvider class, which manages authentication state in a Flutter app. It handles loading sessions, login, logout, token persistence, and real-time service integration. The class interacts with external modules such as ApiClient, RealtimeService, TokenStorage, and User model, providing authentication functionality with support for mock mode.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages authentication state, including loading an existing session, logging in, and logging out. It handles token storage, user data, and real-time service connection.

methods.name: AuthProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the AuthProvider with ApiClient and RealtimeService instances.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates an AuthProvider instance with proper token getter wiring.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads existing session from local storage, sets user and token accordingly, and establishes real-time connection if applicable.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, including mock mode support; updates token, user state, and real-time connection.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the session, token, user, and disconnects real-time services.
